description: Actions waiting for approval (or in another state), with the exact call. With an installed approval-risk model, pending actions sort by risk descending and include risk (0–1) and risk_features (top two advisory signals). No model means no score and newest first. Only a person decides in the dashboard.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...
